description: Tribunal: add evidence. WHEN: attach an evidence entry to a case you are a party to (complainant or respondent). kind is a short tag (chat_log, trade_receipt, screenshot_ref,.), summary max 500 chars, ref is an opaque reference that is stored, never fetched. Evidence closes once a verdict is reached. Example: tribunal_add_evidence {"case_id":"<case_id>","kind":"<kind>","summary":"<summary>"}
